description_en: Queries the status of a user account by calling DescribeUserStatus
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserStatus查询用户账号状态
name: DescribeUserStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh_cn: Chinese (Simplified). This is the default value.
en_us: English (US)
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh_cn：默认值，中文（简体）。
en_us：英文（美国）
parameters.name: lang

UserStatus.description_en: The details of the current logon account
UserStatus.description_zh: 返回当前登录账号详情列表

AccessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID authorized by the user

AssetRoleAuthed.description_en:
Indicates whether the current logon account has authorized the service-linked role for DSC asset synchronization. Valid values:
true: authorized.
false: not authorized
AssetRoleAuthed.description_zh:
当前登录账号是否已授权DSC 资产同步的服务角色权限。取值：
true：已授权。
false：未授权

AuditClosable.description_en:
Indicates whether SQL Explorer can be disabled. Valid values:
true: can be disabled.
false: cannot be disabled
AuditClosable.description_zh:
是否可以关闭sql洞察。取值：
true：可以。
false：不可以

AuditReleasable.description_en:
Indicates whether SQL Explorer can be released. Valid values:
true: can be released.
false: cannot be released
AuditReleasable.description_zh:
是否可以释放sql洞察。
true：可以。
false：不可以

Authed.description_en:
Indicates whether the current logon account has authorized DSC to access RAM. Valid values:
true: authorized.
false: not authorized
Authed.description_zh:
当前登录账号是否已授权DSC RAM的权限。取值：
true：已授权。
false：未授权

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the DSC service purchased by the current logon account. Valid values:
PREPAY: subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
ChargeType.description_zh:
当前登录账号购买DSC服务的付费类型。取值：
PREPAY：预付费。
POSTPAY：后付费

DataManagerRole.description_en:
The permissions of the current account. Valid values:
0: has management or read-only permissions for Data Security Center.
1: has data domain management permissions
DataManagerRole.description_zh:
当前账号拥有的权限。取值：
0: 拥有数据安全中心的管理权限或只读权限。
1: 拥有数据域管理权限

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Data Security Center product purchased by the Alibaba Cloud account
InstanceId.description_zh: 主账号购买的数据安全中心产品实例ID

InstanceNum.description_en: The number of instances in the current logon account
InstanceNum.description_zh: 当前登录账号包含的实例数量

LabStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the asset lab feature is enabled. Valid values:
1: enabled.
0: not enabled
LabStatus.description_zh:
是否开通资产实验室功能。取值：
1：已开通。
0：未开通

OssTotalSize.description_en: The total OSS storage capacity. Unit: bytes

ProtectionDays.description_en: The total number of days that user assets have been protected
ProtectionDays.description_zh: 累计保护用户资产的天数

Purchased.description_en:
Indicates whether the DSC service is purchased. Valid values:

true: purchased.
false: not purchased
Purchased.description_zh:
是否购买DSC服务。取值：

true：已购买。
false：未购买

ReleaseDays.description_en: The number of days from expiration to release. Unit: days
ReleaseDays.description_zh: 过期到释放的时间。单位：天

RemainDays.description_en: The remaining days of the protection period for assets in the current logon account
RemainDays.description_zh: 当前登录账号中资产的保护期剩余天数

Trail.description_en:
Indicates whether the current logon account is using a trial version of DSC. Valid values:
true: trial.
false: non-trial
Trail.description_zh:
当前登录账号是否试用DSC服务。取值：
true：试用。
false：非试用

UseAgentAudit.description_en:
Indicates whether the Agent audit feature has been used. Valid values:
1: has been used.
0: has not been used
UseAgentAudit.description_zh:
是否曾经使用过Agent审计功能。取值：
1：使用过。
0：未使用过

UseInstanceNum.description_en: The number of instances that are used

UseOssSize.description_en: The used OSS storage capacity. Unit: bytes
UseOssSize.description_zh: 已使用的OSS存储量。单位：字节
